headquarters.zh: 烏拉圭蒙特維多（行政秘書處）

nature.en: Regional customs union and trade bloc (intergovernmental)
nature.zh: 區域關稅同盟暨經貿集團（政府間組織）

purpose.en: South American countries remove tariffs among themselves and apply a common external tariff, and negotiate trade deals as one bloc (e.g. with the EU).
purpose.zh: 南美國家彼此取消關稅、對外採用共同關稅，並以集團身分對外洽簽貿易協定（例如與歐盟的協定）。

members.note: Full State Party since July 2024 (accession protocol of 2015 ratified by all members); still phasing in Mercosur rules during a transition period.

Suspended since Dec 2016 and, under the democratic clause (Ushuaia Protocol), since 5 Aug 2017 in all rights and obligations. Readmission discussed in 2026 (Brazil open, Argentina opposed) but no decision as of Nov 2026.
Became associate state at the Dec 2024 Montevideo summit.

notes: Official Mercosur 'Countries' page lists States Parties Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay, Uruguay, Venezuela (suspended) and Associated States Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Panama, Peru, Suriname.

Venezuela readmission: Brazil VP Alckmin (Apr 2026) said the suspension would be 'rediscussed'; Argentina vetoed it informally at the 68th summit (Luque, Paraguay, 29-30 Jun 2026). Status unchanged as of 2026-11-16.
Colombia (Mar 2026) said it would seek full membership; no formal accession as of Nov 2026, so it remains an associate.
Bolivia's associate status was superseded by full membership in 2024, so it is listed only as member.
Observers (e.g. Mexico, New Zealand) are not listed because the official page does not list them.
mercosur.int main site was behind a bot check; the official beta site page was used.
